selection.rule: Retain every published generation cell for this protocol, including zero observations; missing cells remain not-run.

evaluation.P0: Keep this protocol and its observed-unit denominator; collapse source-generation labels for an inventory only.

blockers.message: Published cells aggregate replay units. Clone identities, repeated-clone links and individual outcomes are not resolved by the selected tables.
Starting Cit- phenotype and protocol context define a coarse present view. Equal phenotype does not establish equal genotype or complete present state.

Collapsing source generations supports a descriptive census. Scoring needs a reviewed model for aggregate counts and clone dependence, or additional unit-level evidence with a reviewed evaluation design.
Different source backgrounds and repeated clones are not assumed exchangeable. No history permutation or new significance calculation is executed.
